cruise_selection: planned first0.5s mean speed >=.55m/s, first1s absolute heading increments <=.35rad, pelvis heading within45deg of planned initial direction, selected diffusion sample >=0, after1.2s startup; independent of actual speed

coverage.definition: union of .75m planar neighborhoods around actual root samples, intersected with native known-free cell centers; exploration vicinity, not body contact footprint

limits: Stopping and deceleration for turns or safety can fall below .5m/s and are separately reported.
Measured velocities are physical root instantaneous velocities; .5s smoothing is a diagnostic only and does not change rendered motion.
These are local operational criteria, not author benchmark metrics.
